summary:
Buy 31 ceiling-mounted air devices for this renovation, all Price, per the GRILLES schedule on M601 and the tags on M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan).

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS - 28 total:
- Tag A: 5 ea - Price SCD, 6\" round neck, white, 4-way (75/75/75/90/130 CFM)
- Tag B: 4 ea - Price SCD, 8\" round neck, white, 4-way (150/150/140/140 CFM)
- Tag C: 15 ea - Price SCD, 10\" round neck, white, 4-way (250,200,250,250,250,200,350,350,350,300,375,375,300,375,375 CFM)
- Tag D: 1 ea - Price SCD, 12\" round neck, white, 4-way (500 CFM)
A-D are louvered-face square 4-cone steel diffusers with full-faced louvers, factory insulated backpan, in 24x24 panels for lay-in ceiling, each with a radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal). NC not to exceed 35.
- Tag J: 3 ea - Price SMD, 12x12 face with 8\" round neck, white, 4-way, high-capacity louvered face, with opposed blade damper and flanged frame for surface mounting (175/150/150 CFM) - these are in the toilet/shower areas with hard ceilings.

CEILING RETURN GRILLES - 3 total:
- Tag F: 3 ea - Price 80, 24\" x 24\" core, white, 1/2\"x1/2\"x1/2\" all-aluminum eggcrate, core-only panel for 24x24 lay-in grid, no damper. The two in MTG ROOM 106 get a new 24x24 lined (1\" liner) plenum on top (keynote 4).

Ceiling supply air totals 6,550 CFM.

ALSO ON THE SAME ORDER, but WALL-mounted not ceiling (15 ea):
- Tag E: 4 ea Price 95, 30x18 return, primecoat (MP Room 112) - marked * = field-verify exact size before ordering
- Tag G: 4 ea Price 95, 36x36 transfer grille, primecoat, top elevation 14'-8\" AFF
- Tag H: 3 ea Price 520D, 18x8 double-deflection supply, primecoat, with OBD (550 CFM ea)
- Tag I: 4 ea Price 520D, 14x8 double-deflection sidewall supply, primecoat, with OBD (450 CFM ea) - marked * = field verify size
E, G, H and I are primecoat only and receive 2 coats of field paint - verify color with the architect. Total supply air across all 35 supply devices is exactly 10,000 CFM.

TWO MORE ITEMS:
- 1 ea 14x14 eggcrate, Price model 82, mounted in the soffit with insect screen on the backside - outside-air intake, M101 keynote 19. It carries no letter tag.
- EF-1, EF-2 (Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM ea) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) are ceiling exhaust fans supplied with an integral grille and factory grille-mounted motion sensor - do NOT order separate ceiling grilles for these three locations.

HOW I VERIFIED IT: I counted the hexagonal device tags on M101 geometrically - 49 hexagons, of which 46 carry a letter tag (A5, B4, C15, D1, E4, F3, G4, H3, I4, J3) and 3 carry only a CFM (the EF integral-grille tags). The supply CFM sums to exactly 10,000, which confirms nothing was missed or double-counted. MD101 (demolition) adds nothing to buy - it only removes existing grilles or leaves them in place.

WATCH OUT FOR: coordinate all ceiling device locations with the lighting layout, sprinkler heads and ceiling grid per architectural RCP A6-1 (M601 general note 3), and field-verify sizes on the E and I grilles before ordering.
